answer: Each new identity posts a 500 POA bond locked 20 epochs, marked with a unique pigment code, so vouchers are public. A sybil farm is an orchard planted in one day: hundreds of trees, one root, one dye. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if it holds, all its bonds slash together. 100 clones cost 50,000 POA, lost on one dispute; an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards. A bond surviving 20 epochs is a relic of proven history, raising weight.
